# GH Sales Lumber & Flooring

> Locally owned building materials store at 1113 N 39th St, Nampa, Idaho 83687, serving Nampa, Boise, Meridian, Caldwell and the whole Treasure Valley since 2022. Discount LVP, waterproof laminate, engineered and solid hardwood, and carpet, plus Japanese Sugi cedar, lumber, fencing and decking. Flooring and carpet installation available. Phone or text 208-606-0899, email info@ghsalesllc.com.

Key facts:
- Flooring: luxury vinyl plank (LVP), waterproof laminate, engineered and solid hardwood, and carpet at low prices. In-stock flooring is ready to pick up; special-order styles can be ordered with matching transitions and stair nosing.
- Installation: flooring and carpet installation is available (call or text for a quote).
- Japanese Sugi cedar: tongue and groove for sauna walls, ceilings, soffits and siding, and Sugi boards for decks and building projects.
- Also carries lumber and beams, redwood fence pickets and cedar fence boards, decking, paneling, siding and trim, roofing and more. Inventory changes often; the online catalog is updated daily.
- Pickup at the Nampa store unless shipping is arranged.
- Typical hours: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Wednesday 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM; Friday 11:00 AM to 5:30 PM; Sundays by appointment. Hours vary, so please call or text ahead.
